notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and its evidence at e7ed622. The guide's Sources note was checked on 28 October on the 27 October build, which is the installed one: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02), so items citing it carry that build. The evidence's older sections were checked on 0.1.78-3795b4c (6 October) and 0.1.78-c1fa197 (13 October). Where they disagree with the c1fa197 fixes (#200, Done: open text wraps, one checkbox, the Terms link works from the keyboard, a disabled row still opens, regular-weight label) or the dbe0e02 section (#409, #357), the newer ones were used. The installed ExpandableCheckbox source was read to confirm that the 6 October facts recorded here still hold: the toggle's forced XS / Secondary / Low modes, the clamp on the label only, and children not clamped. The 6 October difference 'the Figma link fills the row, the package link hugs its text' is not recorded: the installed source gives the Idle link Fill. The guide names a Checkbox Item as the alternative for a short option, so that avoidWhen rule uses CheckboxItem. The upstream mdx's CheckboxGroup and Accordion alternatives are in the evidence only, not the guide, so they are not recorded. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every example) and no other modes. They use the guide's own KYC consent copy. The In context example keeps the KYC row and the Open account Button but leaves out the guide's short WhatsApp row, which the guide's own Do & Don't would send to a Checkbox Item. For the same reason, the renamed-toggle example uses the long KYC consent rather than the guide's 'I agree' row. Not recorded as gaps, per the pack's rules: the label and link in Color Mode Dark, and the #200 accessibility faults, all fixed by c1fa197 or dbe0e02. Not recorded: style and labelStyle, which the building rules keep off Coin components, and the mode collections the evidence does not describe.

evidenceFacts.name: onValueChange
evidenceFacts.description: Space and Enter each tick or untick the box with one onValueChange per press, controlled or not, open or closed; the Terms link and Read more / Read less never tick it.
evidenceFacts.quote: Space ticks and unticks the box with one onValueChange per press, controlled or not, open or closed; Enter does the same and Space doesn't scroll the page.

evidenceFacts.name: onLinkPress
evidenceFacts.description: Enter on the Terms link calls onLinkPress once and doesn't tick the box.
evidenceFacts.quote: Enter on the Terms link calls `onLinkPress` once, with no TypeError, and doesn't tick the box.

evidenceFacts.name: disabled
evidenceFacts.description: The row is exposed as disabled and can't be ticked, but Read more stays enabled and opens the text.
evidenceFacts.quote: Disabled: the row has `aria-disabled` and `tabindex="-1"` and can't be ticked, but Read more stays enabled and opens the text.

evidenceFacts.name: collapsedLines
evidenceFacts.description: Clamps the label only: the link is outside the clamp, so a long label puts the link on a second line (the Idle row is then 38 px tall).
evidenceFacts.quote: The label clamps to `collapsedLines` with an ellipsis; the link is outside the clamp, so a long label puts the link on a second line (38 px tall).

evidenceFacts.name: children
evidenceFacts.description: Children wrap but are not clamped when Idle.
evidenceFacts.quote: The `children` path wraps but is not clamped when Idle.

evidenceFacts.name: disableTruncation
evidenceFacts.description: Wraps the label in full when Idle.

evidenceFacts.name: readMoreLabel
